htmlBody:
Something new just shipped on the board. Today’s care is one Goldilocks move: not too much information, not too little meaning — pick the note that fits today’s noticing.

If you want a map for that: More engines, empty workshops: when linear AI horsepower stops buying progress. Also new on the board: The AI shame campaign, explained: it’s not just about the tools. A hospitality note on the board, if you need it: Linear as the shadow of fractal — keep the dials, chart the body.

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.

highlights.title: More engines, empty workshops: when linear AI horsepower stops buying progress
highlights.blurb: Bigger models, louder race talk, quieter benches. The collapse isn’t the computer breaking — it’s the belief that one more upgrade will fill the room. Fair Exchange tip clause on.

highlights.title: The AI shame campaign, explained: it’s not just about the tools
highlights.blurb: Vilify the curiosity, lock the keys, call it care. Leading AI platforms already disagree on adult topics — and the real casualty is still creative force. Fair Exchange tip clause on.

highlights.title: Address four, glyph eight — and why Be and O keep showing up
highlights.blurb: Address four, glyph eight. Those labels rhyme with Be (Z=4) and O (Z=8) as story geometry — useful, memorable, not a prophecy that golden digits wrote the table. Fair Exchange tip clause on.
